parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const alertname = $('Webhook').item.json.body?.alerts?.[0]?.labels?.alertname || ''; const map = { PartialCommitDetected: 'payment_partial_commits_total', DBPoolExhausted: 'db_pool_exhausted_total', IdempotencyViolation: 'payment_idempotency_violations_total', FraudCascadeDetected: 'fraud_cascade_events_total', ReconciliationDriftHigh: 'reconciliation_drift_usd', ReconciliationDriftCritical: 'reconciliation_drift_usd', WebhookRetryStorm: 'webhook_retry_storm_total', DeadlockDetected: 'payment_deadlock_events_total', TransactionCacheGrowing: 'payment_transaction_cache_size', HighErrorRate: 'app_error_rate' }; return map[alertname] || 'app_error_rate'; })() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'You are an SRE. Analyze the incident using the provided metrics and code, then propose a fix. Return valid JSON only with keys: root_cause (string), fix_summary (string, 1-2 sentences suitable for a PR description), patched_code (string, the FULL corrected content of the file - not a diff), risk (one of: low, medium, high). Incident: ' + JSON.stringify($json.incident) + ' Metrics: ' + JSON.stringify($json.metrics) + ' Current file (' + ($json.github?.path || 'app.py') + '): ' + ($json.repo_files?.app_py || '') }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ message: 'AI fix: ' + $('Patch Validator').item.json.ai.fix_summary, content: Buffer.from($('Patch Validator').item.json.ai.patched_code).toString('base64'), sha: $('Patch Validator').item.json.repo_file_sha, branch: $('Patch Validator').item.json.branch }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ title: 'AI incident fix: ' + $('Patch Validator').item.json.incident.name, head: $('Patch Validator').item.json.branch, base: 'main', body: 'Root cause: ' + $('Patch Validator').item.json.ai.root_cause + '

Fix summary: ' + $('Patch Validator').item.json.ai.fix_summary + '

Risk: ' + $('Patch Validator').item.json.ai.risk + '
